zh: 技能中心新增全员开放与未全员开放状态徽标与分类筛选，超管可清晰查看并快速过滤团队共享技能。
强化微信聊天记录与通道访问隔离，非超级管理员用户严禁查看微信会话、聊天历史或执行通道调用。
完善 AutoGLM 与第三方 Agent 连接器权限管控，未向全员开放的功能在 iOS 端、Mac 桌面端与 Web 端对非超管用户全面隐匿。
en: Add shared-with-all and unshared badges and category filters to Skill Hub for immediate team visibility.
Enforce strict privacy isolation on WeChat chat threads and history, completely blocking access from non-superadmin users.
Fortify access controls on AutoGLM and third-party agent connectors, keeping unshared skills and desktop bridges invisible across iOS, macOS, and Web.
